company.name: Eon Dental
company.shortDescription: Eon Dental designs and manufactures clear dental aligners, offering innovative orthodontic solutions.
company.description: Eon Dental specializes in the design and manufacturing of clear dental aligners, offering a comprehensive solution for orthodontic care. With a focus on innovation, Eon Dental provides Eon One, a white-label clear aligner solution that enables clients to build and enhance their own brands. The company plays a significant role in the clear aligner industry, offering products that cater to the needs of dental professionals and their patients. Eon Dental is committed to improving orthodontic treatment options through its expertise in medical equipment manufacturing, supported by a team that includes professionals like Dr. Reham Kilano, Clinical Affairs Manager, and Dana Dwaik, Head of Product Management.
